remarks: Rare 15-acre countryside parcel offering a beautiful mix of wooded acreage and open clearings, formerly operated as a Christmas tree farm with mature evergreens still present throughout the property. The property features a charming one-room schoolhouse, believed to date back to the 1800s, adding unique historic character and presence. Zoned agricultural and suitable for residential use, offering the opportunity to build a single-family home with additional outbuildings. Electric available. A great opportunity to create a private retreat or build in a rural setting.
